name: RenderWorld
signature: public sealed partial class RenderWorld : IDisposable

docs.summary: A scene's renderable content. Mutation is host thread only and recorded for extraction: setters write a host copy and a dirty bit, `Extract` copies what changed into the render copy, and the render thread turns that into GPU records. Storage is struct of arrays keyed by a dense index with a free list.
The baked light probes that light renderables without a lightmap, sampled at their bounds center, or null for none. The data is copied. Host thread.
A point the light probes are sampled at for draws that are not renderables, such as a provider's items, which name it in [`Probe`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.DrawItem~Probe). Host thread.

docs.summary: Captures a probe, prefilters it and reads it back for the host to keep, then show through [`Cubemap`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Cubemap). `done` runs on the host thread in a later [`SubmitFrame`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.Renderer~SubmitFrame). Host thread.

The sky's light as order 2 harmonics, the raw radiance [`Sky`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.AmbientMode~Sky) lights with. Read back after each sky capture and taken at a later [`SubmitFrame`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.Renderer~SubmitFrame), so it trails the sky by a frame or two. Zero until the first arrives. Host thread.
How many sky ambient read backs arrived, 0 before the first, so hosts see when [`SkyAmbient`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.RenderWorld~SkyAmbient) changed.

The ambient light a surface facing `normal` receives from the environment, as the shaders give it without a lightmap or probe: uniform, hemisphere or the sky's harmonics, times the intensity. Host thread.

docs.summary: A set of the host's own items found by where they are. Its index is the renderer's for the name, the same in every world, so materials shared by worlds read the same set; a renderer has room for 13 names. It draws from the next SubmitFrame. Host thread.
How the world's local light shadows are stored and sized. Host thread, read at SubmitFrame.
Features every view of the world runs. Host thread.
GPU work run once a frame outside any view, with the world's built in LightProbes, LocalShadows and CaptureFill. Host thread.
Host geometry drawn into each view through its passes without being renderables. Host thread.

members.name: SetBones
members.signature: public void SetBones(RenderableHandle handle, ReadOnlySpan<Float4x4> skinMatrices)

docs.summary: Skins the renderable's mesh, which needs bone index and weight streams, with a matrix per bone taking the rest pose into the renderable's object space. A bone index of 0 is no bone, 1 the first matrix. An empty span stops skinning. Nothing changes when the matrices equal the stored ones. A skinned renderable culls by its bounds override, which should hold every pose.

members.name: SetBlendShapeWeights
members.signature: public void SetBlendShapeWeights(RenderableHandle handle, ReadOnlySpan<float> weights)

docs.summary: Weights the mesh's blend shapes, one per shape from 0 to 100 like Prowl, past either end to over or undershoot. Shapes past the span weigh 0, and an empty span rests every shape. Nothing changes when the weights equal the stored ones. A renderable whose mesh has blend shapes culls by its bounds override, which should hold every shape.
Removes the world from its renderer at the next frame. Host thread.
